name: cache-status
description: Band row showing whether the prompt cache is warm or cold, time left, cold restarts this session, and an opt-in guard before sending into a lapsed cache

coldSendGuard.title: Cold-send guard
coldSendGuard.description: Ask before a prompt is sent into a lapsed cache when the context is big (Send / Compact now / Cancel)

bigTokens.title: Big context (tokens)
bigTokens.description: Context size in tokens above which the cold-send guard asks

expiryNotice.title: Heads-up before the cache expires
expiryNotice.description: When you have left a session with a warm cache, a notification about a minute before it expires (desktop and mobile apps only; dropped if you come back first)
